name: Leighton Executive Black Stick Umbrella
description: Straight to business, the Leighton Executive Black Stick Umbrella is sleek in all black. Genuine leather wraps around the cork-style wooden hook handle, a striking style carried up to the ferrule. Simply designed, the generously sized canopy is coated in Teflon for extra water and stain resistance while the wind resistant frame and automatic open mechanism provide easy operating. A revamped classic, be prepared for any unexpected weather with the smart and stylish Executive Umbrella at your side.
